title: TECT-owner physical-empty bounded test execution remains blocked
question: With the finite-regulator functional, reference, normalization, finite parts, regulator, volume, boundary condition and limit order held unchanged, can the current TECT owner admit E and evaluate the F_total[G_*]-F_total[E] sign, full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability?
method: Hash-pin the prior R-434 owner execution together with R-427/R-420 preregistration, R-418 E boundary, R-170 applicability firewall, R-169 owner boundary and EXP-000790 future same-parent contract.
Compare the fifteen fixed fields against R-434 and verify exact equality; keep the G_* minus E orientation unchanged.

Preregister E as the named physical-empty slot with explicit representative, measure/algebra, normalization, boundary preparation and local physical-criterion requirements, while rejecting zero/P1 aliasing.

Run the primary, independent field-order control, hostile mutations, integrated verifier and Lean R441; stop before energy, derivative or Hessian evaluation when the common finite parent or admitted E is absent.
finding: R-441 primary passes 13/13, independent control 13/13, hostile controls reject 7/7 mutations, integrated verification passes 19/19 and Lean R441 compiles. The unchanged fifteen-field contract remains identity-equal to R-434; E is preregistered but not admitted. Therefore F_total[G_*]-F_total[E], full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability are all BLOCKED_NOT_EVALUATED; no numerical energy, derivative or Hessian is formed.
decision_reason: The current TECT owner still supplies no single hash-pinned finite F_total domain containing both the Reading-H covariance owner G_* and a normalized physical-empty E. The requested test therefore stops at input admissibility. This append-only execution is a blocked result, not a sign, stationarity, stability or nonexistence theorem.
decision_scope: Fresh TECT-owner execution with the fifteen-field R-434/R-427/R-420 contract, exact F_total[G_*]-F_total[E] orientation and E preregistration unchanged; no energy, derivative, Hessian or limit evaluation.
boundary: R-441 does not evaluate the three physical quantities and does not identify E with zero or P1. It does not imply a physical vacuum, Yang-Mills dynamics, a mass gap, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
next_action: Supply one owner-approved hash-pinned finite parent containing both G_* and an admitted normalized E, then freeze common finite parts, regulator, volume, boundary, limit order, tangent, symmetry projector and error budgets before rerunning the unchanged tests.

adversarial_review.check: E remains an uninstantiated slot and zero/P1 replacement is rejected.
The fifteen fields remain unsupplied in one common finite parent, so G_* and E cannot be compared.
No unspecified counterterm or shift is allowed to manufacture E or an absolute comparison.
A covariance-owner condition is not promoted to full Reading-H stationarity without a full tangent and residual budget.
No projected Hessian is formed without a common orbit tangent, projector and error budget.
Input inadmissibility is not converted into a sign or nonexistence theorem.
The result remains T0, claim-nonbearing and outside Yang-Mills or mass-gap claims.

no_overclaim: R-441 records a blocked owner-input execution only. It does not evaluate a sign, stationarity or stability and makes no Yang-Mills or mass-gap claim.
assumptions: The six hash-pinned authorities above are the active TECT-owner boundaries.
The requested orientation is G_* minus E and all three tests must share one regulated parent.
The fifteen contract fields are identity-locked; a locked field name does not invent an owner value.
A physical-empty branch requires a normalized representative, measure or algebra, boundary preparation and a local physical criterion beyond a zero label.
Input-admissibility failure is a valid bounded-test outcome and is not a numerical sign or stability theorem.
Symmetry projection requires the exact orbit tangent and a regulated Hessian error budget.
missing_assumptions: A hash-pinned finite-regulator F_total with a common domain containing G_* and E.
A normalized, admitted E representative with measure/algebra, boundary preparation and a no-condensate or clustering criterion.
Common reference, normalization, finite-part counterterms and renormalization conditions.
Fixed regulator/cutoff, physical volume, boundary condition and explicit limit order.
Deterministic finite-parent maps for G_* and E, a full admissible tangent and exact symmetry orbit tangent.
A transverse projector, regulated Hessian, stationarity residual budget and numerical/limit error budgets.
evidence_level: T0 / EXECUTED APPEND-ONLY TECT-OWNER INPUT-ADMISSIBILITY AUDIT; all three physical quantities BLOCKED_NOT_EVALUATED
non_claims: No identification of E with zero, P1, a Gaussian state or an equilibrium phase.
No physical-vacuum, below-empty-space, Yang-Mills, mass-gap, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A conclusion.
No thermodynamic, continuum, OS/KMS/GNS, Hamiltonian spectral or absolute-energy conclusion.
